verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Pipecat publishes an llms.txt at docs.pipecat.ai, and its docs are served as .md pages. The official CLI also ships a context-hub, which registers as an MCP server with your coding agent and builds a local docs/examples/API index, and a runtime probe confirmed it exists. The quickstart scaffold additionally writes AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md. missing for 10: independent community or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming the llms.txt or context-hub output effectively.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: pipecat context-hub install registers the hub as an MCP server with your coding agent and builds the local index
context-hub (local docs/examples/API index built for coding agents)
Install the Pipecat CLI and scaffold the quickstart project (also writes AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md)
